units_precision.reason: Required in S5A-S01/S03/S04/S06: preserve signed canonical nm and typed quantity identity independently of display unit/precision, pan/zoom and device scale. Inspector values and Common/Mixed comparisons use the shared quantity/context service, never hardcoded mm or rounded labels as canonical input. Include the inherited 5080001 nm rounded-display example and distinct exact values that display identically. Exact consumer/fixture binding remains required; this does not activate Project or Global settings.

authority_refs.marker: ## Selection, coordinate frames and snap — F3/F4 (inherited)

numeric_entry.reason: Required as a read-only boundary in S5A-S04/S05/S06: selection and Inspector surfaces expose no editable numeric commit path. Existing S5B seams remain visible, disabled and explained; keyboard activation and typing cannot emit design Operations. Preserve exact values behind formatted labels. Numeric parsing/edit commit/no-op behavior belongs to later authorized authoring, not new S5A functionality.

selection_identity.reason: Required across all six groups: the nine PM026 subjects map one-to-one; Object/Compound enumerate stable authored identities, Run retains typed origin and derives membership per revision, and Global Net/Bus remain semantic identities. Proposal and Review stay distinct. Verify focus membership, no auto-promotion, stale drop/report, no substitution/resurrection, exact same-identity projection and related-only baseline. The 256-id envelope cap never truncates subject identity or membership truth.

grid_snap.reason: Required in S5A-S01/S03/S06: final world-space rectangle/lasso geometry and authored qualification anchors determine exact membership. Camera path, zoom, device scale, grid visibility and display precision cannot quantize or move authored geometry. Snap and quantize authoring remain outside S5A; reuse shared camera/hit infrastructure without treating point-hit tests as bounded region proof.

authority_refs.marker: ## Selection, coordinate frames and snap — F3/F4 (inherited)

undo_cancel.reason: Required in S5A-S01/S02/S05: Escape or focus/capture loss cancels an active region/evaluation atomically and preserves the prior selection; idle Escape clears selection under the ratified grammar. Selection adds no journal entry or private undo stack. Authorized fixture revision/undo transitions preserve surviving identities, drop missing members with notice, never substitute recreated ids and never resurrect dropped selections.

persistence_recovery.reason: Required in S5A-S02/S05: capture exact source/journal/model identities before and after read-only interactions and reopen. Selection/inspection cannot mutate authored files or history; project replacement clears project-scoped selection and stale restored identities drop/report. Fixture setup transactions and recovery evidence must be distinguished from selection effects. No new Project writer protocol, recovery engine or claim of writer-authority completion is introduced.

library_connectivity.reason: Required in S5A-S01/S02/S03/S04: preserve ratified parent/child granularity, including board pad-to-footprint acquisition; verify typed Run/Global Net/Bus derivation and semantic membership from resolved connectivity, not names or geometric coincidence. Component-symbol and definition-instance relations are not same-identity selection. Fixtures must bind exact identities/revisions; no library placement, binding mutation or wire-formation mechanism is added.

settings_scope.reason: Required in S5A-S03/S04/S05: selection is Project-workspace consumer state, not per-pane authority or Global preference state. Focus, visibility and Inspector scope changes preserve shared membership except explicit selection actions and lifecycle rules. In preconfigured Project contexts, unit presentation cannot rescale geometry or mutate other Projects/Global defaults. Setup of differing contexts uses its own authorized path; S5A does not add settings controls or activate reserved preferences.
